noMoreInformation.name: Sipakufunikanso uthenga wina
noMoreInformation.description:
Tili ndi uthenga okwanira wokhudzana ndi {item} pakadali pano.

Kuti mupitilize ndi kafukufukuyu, sankhani "Pitilizani" batani lilimunsimo ndipo tikusankhilani zakudya zomwe zikufuna kuwonjezera zonena.

Kapenanso, sankhani zakudya zomwe zili kumanzere ngati mukufuna kuwunikira pachinachake.

Mulemba chakudya ndi chakumwa pachokha pachokha.

Dinani Kapena gwiritsani ntchito batani lolowera kapena kubwelera mbuyo kuti muonjezere zakudya ndi zakumwa.

Simukuyenerakumulemba mulingo omwe munadya, koma dzina lokha la zakudyazo.
